description: This file defines UTF-8 handling utilities and encoding-related functions used in a software project, including functions for string width calculation, BOM handling, and encoding validation.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the escape sequence for display modes.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a UTF-8 string, considering escape sequences.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a UTF-8 string with specified length and skip ANSI sequences.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a null-terminated UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if the given text is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given encoding name refers to UTF-8.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names refer to the same encoding.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted UTF-8 text to a FILE stream.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips BOM if present at the start of a UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text to a strbuf with indentation and width options.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data to a strbuf with indentation and width options.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns a UTF-8 string within a strbuf according to specified alignment and width.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a UTF-16/32 encoding contains a prohibited BOM as per the Unicode standard.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Determines if a UTF-16/32 encoded data misses a required BOM based on endianness assumptions.

methods.name: char * reencode_string(const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
char * reencode_string_len(const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)

ctags.name: reencode_string
ctags.signature: (const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
